text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: We're investigating sporadic double-metering and duplicated embedding results tied to producer retries after broker ACK timeouts. Customers may see duplicated usage lines and repeated embedding vectors. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2124000000-ingest-ack-amplification

maya-sre: Observable: a spike in producer retransmits correlated with broker ack latency >250ms. Duplicate ingest events ~0.6% across ap-south-1 and us-east1. No increased 5xxs on user-facing endpoints yet, but metering shows duplicate records.

raj-telemetry: Initial hypothesis: recent broker tuning (acked.timeout lowered to 100ms) + transient GC pauses on brokers -> producers interpret delay as missing ack and re-send. Reverting ack-timeout to 500ms on canary broker now. Canary restart on kafka-broker-7 (ap-south-1). ETA ~8m.

olivia-ingest: As a hotfix I'm flipping producer feature-flag "producer-idempotence=on" for high-volume ingress clients so they will dedupe on the client side until backfill completes. Flag change rolling via feature-flag service. Will patch SDKs if needed.

peter-billing: Putting affected ingestion window on hold to avoid immediate double-charges and scheduling a reconciliation job that will remove duplicate metering entries. Billing hold ref: bh-2124000000. We'll auto-credit duplicates confirmed by reconcile.

anya-support: Draft customer message pinned in #support-ops: "We're investigating duplicated embedding usage linked to backend ingest retries; we've paused billing for the affected window and will automatically credit confirmed duplicates. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2124000000-ingest-ack-amplification" Please review tone and add any required contact links.

ops-automation-bot: Runbook "ingest-ack-amplification" executed and pagers notified. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/ingest-ack-amplification

raj-telemetry: Mitigations in flight:
- 2124000065: increased broker ack timeout on canary to 500ms and restarted kafka-broker-7
- 2124000120: enabled producer-side idempotence flag for top 10 ingress clients
- 2124000200: queued dedupe-reconcile job (job id: reconcile-2124000000) to run post-rollback

maya-sre: Quick detection snippet for eng-telemetry to find duplicates by event fingerprint:
```
# list duplicate event fingerprints in the last hour
kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --topic metering.events --offset -10000 --max-messages 20000 | jq -r '.fingerprint' | sort | uniq -c | awk '$1>1'
```
If you see >0 results, dump sample messages and tag #telemetry.

olivia-ingest: Canary on ap-south-1 shows duplicate stream rate down ~85% after canary ack-timeout revert. Rolling update to remaining brokers in 2 waves.

peter-billing: We'll block invoice generation for ingestion window 2123996400-2124003600 and await the reconcile job output. Finance will prepare credits and a customer report.

anya-support: Support copy (quick):
"Thanks  we detected duplicated embedding events caused by backend retries and have paused billing for the affected window. We're running an automated reconciliation and will credit affected accounts. Please share request IDs if you continue to see duplicates. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2124000000-ingest-ack-amplification"

ops-automation-bot: Pager rota active. If duplication persists after 2124001200 escalate to on-call with traces and sample event fingerprints.

maya-sre: Timeline so far:
- 2123999000: broker tuning change (acked.timeout set to 100ms) rolled out to fleet
- 2123999800: first duplicate signals from reconcile samplers
- 2124000000: incident created and runbook triggered
- 2124000065: canary revert applied to kafka-broker-7
- 2124000300: canary metrics show improvement

raj-telemetry: Next steps: complete broker config revert, run reconcile job to remove duplicate entries, validate billing ledger, and publish postmortem with root cause and long-term fix (make ack-timeout auto-tuned and add end-to-end test).

maya-sre: Current status: partial mitigation succeeding; expect most duplicates gone within 30-45m. Next update in 20m or on any significant change.

incidents-bot: Update posted to status page. Automated follow-up in 20 minutes. :rotating_light:
